events.outcome: The 180-day lifecycle is current and confirmed, but the legacy NT$100/NT$200-per-year floor was not re-established as the current minimum qualifying recharge. Preserve the lifecycle and leave the minimum cost unresolved.

data.acquisitionSummary: Chunghwa Telecom prepaid (Ruyi/Ideal) cards are sold through CHT channels. Current pages document prepaid application and recharge products; eSIM availability for this prepaid route was not confirmed.

keep.action: Recharge qualifying main-account credit before expiry. Current CHT prepaid guidance states the number is valid for 180 days from activation and that qualifying recharge restarts the number-validity period at 180 days.

data.chinaActivation: Application is Taiwan-oriented and requires identity verification; overseas-first activation is not established.
data.kyc: CHT prepaid application requires valid identity documents; current application page should be followed for eligible document combinations.
data.roamingSms: Prepaid mobile data is domestic-only on the reviewed page; voice/SMS roaming details were not fully reconciled.
data.refund: Unused main-account balance can be claimed/transferred under CHT prepaid rules within the documented post-expiry window; promo balances differ.
data.tariffSummary: 180-day prepaid number validity; qualifying main-account recharge restarts the 180-day period. Current minimum qualifying recharge amount remains unresolved.
